message: FORGE-BOUNDARY-1.1 requires an anti-reopen test that passes only when raw mutation calls are guarded across scaffold.py, adopt.py, and upgrade.py, but adopt.py and upgrade.py currently contain those calls and are excluded from the stage write scope; either expand scope or clarify a passing structural rule that does not require editing them.
